item.title: **3 effective strategies for reading non-fiction and biographies**
item.description:
**3 effective strategies for reading non-fiction and biographies**
Scientific and biographical books are packed with information, names, and concepts. Here's how to retain more of what you read:
1. **Take notes as you go.** Record key quotes and facts in a dedicated notebook or your phone's notes app.
2. **Summarize each chapter.** After finishing a chapter, write a brief 5-6 sentence summary in your own words.
3. **Create knowledge maps.** Use tools like Notion or Obsidian to visualize connections between concepts, events, or people mentioned in the book.
These simple habits turn passive reading into active learning—helping you remember and apply what you've read.
#Mutolaa #Reading #NonFiction #LearningTips #Books

item.title: Today we wrapped up the "Mutolaa Marathon" — our reading challenge that puts book knowledge to the test.
item.description:
Today we wrapped up the "Mutolaa Marathon" — our reading challenge that puts book knowledge to the test.
The format combined three stages in just 35 minutes: • 30 multiple-choice questions on the book (15 min) • 10 open-ended questions requiring written answers (10 min) • A creative quest where readers decoded symbols to uncover hidden quotes and their authors (10 min)
Questions covered everything from plot details and character arcs to symbolic meanings — rewarding those who truly engaged with the text, not just skimmed it.
Winners were determined by accuracy and speed, proving that deep reading pays off.
At Mutolaa, we believe reading should be active, challenging, and rewarding. This is how we turn pages into progress.
#Mutolaa #ReadingChallenge #Books #ActiveReading #LiteracyMatters
